notes: Carries forward v2.11.24 freeze/stability repairs and fixes approval permissions. Any full Admin can approve/review any scoped controlled document or Toolbox Talk even when the H&S Manager/Department Manager responsibility is vacant or assigned to someone else. Responsibility assignments remain for ownership, reminders and follow-up rather than acting as an Admin permission gate. Document scope/audience is still required before approval. Adds an early scoped modal observer governor to suppress the legacy v2.10.90 approval decorator feedback loop without adding polling. No SQL required.
